reason: I'm skeptical of supplements unless my doctor brings it up, and nobody has told me I need magnesium. I already forget the vitamins on my counter half the time, and a box of 30 foil sachets is just more trash.
objection: Nobody has said I'm low on magnesium, and a daily sachet means 30 pieces of foil packaging to throw away. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't tell me I need it.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending magnesium for me, plus a plain recyclable pack instead of foil sachets.
